    Our

    Schengen Visa Process

    Navigating the Schengen visa procedure with Waytransit Travels & Tourism entails a straightforward sequence of steps:

    Preliminary Complimentary Consultation

    We shall converse about the nuances of your request, providing a comprehensive overview of the process and ensuring all your particulars and documents are current.

    Remittance of Fees

    This encompasses the expense associated with the support rendered by Waytransit Travels & Tourism throughout your visa application endeavor.

    Compilation of Documents

    This stage includes assembling your passport, current residence visa, and a completed questionnaire. Our case officer may request additional documents or information to facilitate a seamless application process.

    Coordination of Visa Appointment

    We will prepare your documentation set and organize
    an appointment for you.

    Appearance at the Visa Center

    On the appointed day, you must present yourself at the Visa Center with your prepared application packet.

    Awaiting Adjudication

    You can monitor the status of your application through our regular updates.

    Retrieval of Passport

    You may either collect your passport from the Visa Center or opt for delivery services to your specified address upon request.
